issues.title: Missing Critical Sub-Modules
issues.why: The File Inventory lists files 13 through 28 (Release Assets, Checksums, Network, etc.) as 'Active', but their content is not provided in the context. A coder cannot implement the 'Binary-Based Update' strategy without the download/checksum/manifest specs.
issues.fix: Provide the content for files 13-28 or remove references to binary-based updates from the scope.

issues.title: Incomplete Acceptance Criteria
issues.why: The 'Verification' section in 00-overview.md points to a missing file (97-acceptance-criteria.md) and only provides a linter command for cross-links, which does not verify the actual logic (rename-first, handoff, etc.).
issues.fix: Inline the GWT (Given-When-Then) criteria for the rename-first and handoff mechanisms directly into files 03 and 05.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'Hidden' Command Registration
issues.why: Module 08 references a hidden command 'set-source-repo' and 06 references 'update-cleanup', but it doesn't specify the CLI framework (Cobra, etc.) or how to 'hide' them from help output consistently.
issues.fix: Explicitly state that commands must be hidden using the 'Hidden: true' property (Cobra) or equivalent in the technical interface contract.
